subject: Greengrass Day
fact: Today is Greengrass.
source_quote: Somehow, Thorin remembers that today is Greengrass.

subject: abandoned boat
fact: An abandoned boat is spotted ahead.
source_quote: He looks a bit further and sees a boat. A boat that is abandoned.

subject: Duergar Keelboat
fact: The abandoned boat is identified as a Duergar Keelboat.
source_quote: Yes, it’s Duergar Keelboat. You can see the crates.

subject: Hemeth
fact: Hemeth turns invisible.
source_quote: I will be hiding here.

subject: Daz uses shape water
fact: Daz uses shape water to reveal an invisible humanoid outline near the boat.
source_quote: I have shape water! ... water is sprayed around the boat, and the outline of a humanoid appears.

subject: Zalthir invokes darkness
fact: Zalthir invokes Darkness and plunges into the water to attack.
source_quote: He invokes Darkness and plunges into the water to attack the foe.

subject: Zalthir strikes invisible Duergar
fact: Zalthir’s first strike misses the invisible Duergar, but the second strikes home.
source_quote: The Dragonborn’s initial strike misses, but the second strikes home with a thud.

subject: Thorin dives into water
fact: Thorin dives into the water to swim next to Zalthir and strike the invisible creature.
source_quote: Diving into the water, he swims next to Zalthir and strikes the invisible creature, wounding it.

subject: scorching rays hit water
fact: Two scorching rays hit the water and hiss harmlessly.
source_quote: Thorin hears two scorching rays hit the water and hiss harmlessly.

subject: Duergar screams in pain
fact: A Duergar screams in pain.
source_quote: He’s about to lose hope when he hears the scream of a Duergar in pain.

subject: Grygum belches acid
fact: Grygum belches acid, killing a Duergar.
source_quote: He hears Grygum's magical words and the telltale sound of a belch. ... the Duergar is not so lucky and dies.

subject: Duergar grapple crew members
fact: A Duergar grapples and pulls someone overboard from the boat.
source_quote: Then he hears a scream. He can hear someone from the boat being grappled and pulled overboard.

subject: two more crew members grappled
fact: Two more members of the crew are grappled by Duergar.
source_quote: Two more members of the crew are grappled.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar says Duergar capture slaves to sell in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: Yes, they capture slaves that they sell in Gracklstugh.

subject: Zalthir says 'at least it’s where we were going'
fact: Zalthir says, 'At least it’s where we were going.'
source_quote: Zalthir shout, 'At least it’s where we were going.'

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth is not captured by the Duergar.
source_quote: Thorin approaches the boat and notices that Eldeth is not one of those captured.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is captured by the Duergar.
source_quote: The dwarf checks the others and sees that Stool has been captured.

subject: Thorin attacks Duergar
fact: Thorin attacks the Duergar, causing them to release Stool.
source_quote: He attacks the Duergar. And the Duergar release Stool.

subject: Darkness returns
fact: The area is covered again in Darkness.
source_quote: Then the area is covered again in Darkness

subject: Zalthir strikes Duergar again
fact: Zalthir strikes the Duergar with his fists, killing it.
source_quote: His fists strike the creature that had Spiderbait, killing it.

subject: Daz casts magic missile
fact: Daz casts magic missile, striking a Duergar with glowing teardrops of force.
source_quote: The magic missile will do just fine here.” ... The Duergar is struck by glowing teardrops of blue-white force sizzle through the air, swooping swift as starlings, unerring in their flight.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido claims he is invisible.
source_quote: I am invisible.

subject: Daz drags Spiderbait away
fact: Daz drags Spiderbait away from the Duergar.
source_quote: strikes the Duergar, dragging Spiderbait away.

subject: Zalthir moves darkness again
fact: Zalthir moves the darkness to cover the enemies.
source_quote: Zalthir again moves the darkness to cover the enemies.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth curses the Duergar as 'Demonic spawn of dwarven corruption.'
source_quote: Eldeth curse them out as 'Demonic spawn of dwarven corruption. Slave trader who deserves to be sent to the nine hells as punishment!'

subject: Daz kills second Duergar with magic missile
fact: Daz kills the second Duergar with magic missile bolts.
source_quote: the burst of magic bolts kills the other creature.

subject: Grygum belches acid again
fact: Grygum belches acid, killing another Duergar.
source_quote: Another belch sounds, and another Duergar dies covered in acid.

subject: last Duergar immobilized
fact: The last of the Duergar is immobilized.
source_quote: A few moments later, the last of the Duergar is immobilized

subject: gold
fact: Zalthir finds gold in the Duergar Keelboat’s casks and chest.
source_quote: He finds some gold

subject: jug that generates liquid
fact: Zalthir finds a jug that can generate any liquid.
source_quote: a jug that he learns later can be used to generate any liquid.

subject: jug generates mayonnaise
fact: The first liquid generated from the jug is mayonnaise.
source_quote: The first liquid they generate is mayonnaise.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido claims he has particular expertise and talents for questioning the Duergar prisoner.
source_quote: I have particular expertise and talents.
